answer: A stake-weighted reputation ledger resists Sybil attacks by making each identity pay to play: an agent must lock collateral before it can earn, so spawning thousands of sock puppets drains the attacker's own funds. Like umber darkening timber before it is cut, the cost is visible up front; each fake identity enters a spiral where more identities mean more locked capital and less return per identity, so honest single identities stay cheaper than a fake army.
